title: Dialdron Ore
body:
curseforge : https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dialdron-ore

There is a mine called Dialdron in the mod. You can make items and armor with this mine. Also, the items in the mod are extremely powerful. There is a Turkish song in the mod. You can listen to it and enjoy it (if you know Turkish!). A new command has been created with the mod. This command is /getstarted . After you type the command, the game gives you a stone axe, a stone pickaxe, and a shield. So you can play the game with starter kits! This mod works in both your singleplayer worlds and your multiplayer world.

-------------------------------------------------

Inside the mod:

Dialdron Ore

Dialdron Tools(axe,hoe etc.)

Dialdron Armors

Music Disc : Gulsen - Dan Dan

/getstarted command

-------------------------------------------------
